# Issue 5: Chainsaw rule

## Outcome

Only members who passed the induction for a class-C tool (the chainsaw is class C) can borrow it.
Everyone else is told why they cannot.

## Requirements

- When a member whose inductions do not include "C" asks to borrow a class-C item, the system shall refuse with `ok: false`.
- When a member whose inductions include "C" asks to borrow a class-C item that is in, the system shall allow it.
- If a class-C item is refused for a missing induction, the system shall give a reason that names the item.
- Where an item is class A or class B, the system shall not require any induction.
- While a class-C item is in repair or out, the system shall refuse it even for an inducted member.

## Must not change

- `src/auth/` is not edited.
- The existing refusals for items in repair or already out keep their reasons.
- A free class-A tool still goes out to a member with no inductions.
- Money handling (deposits are integer cents) is untouched.

## Out of scope

- Recording or granting inductions, and the desk or server screens.
- Inductions for classes other than C, and any other item rules.
- Changes to the seed data.

## Done when

- The new tests in `tests/items/borrow.test.ts` pass.
- `bun run gate` exits 0.

I wrote the spec and five new tests for issue 5. Two of the five fail on the current code, as intended. The other three pass today because they guard behaviour that must not change. `bun test tests` shows 13 pass and 2 fail, and nothing under `src/` was touched.

I didn't have the triage output, so I read the files myself. The chainsaw (`saw-01`) is safety class C. The seed members hold inductions like `["C"]`. I therefore read "passed the induction" as "has "C" in `inductions`" for class-C items.

**Spec:** `specs/5/SPEC.md` has the five required sections. Its five requirements are:
- A member without the C induction is refused a class-C item.
- A member with the C induction is allowed one that is in.
- The refusal reason names the item.
- Class A and B items need no induction.
- A class-C item that is out or in repair is still refused, even for an inducted member.

**Tests:** I added them to `tests/items/borrow.test.ts` and left the existing tests unchanged.
- **Failing now:**
  - "a member without the C induction cannot take the chainsaw"
  - "the refusal for a missing induction names the chainsaw"
- **Passing already:**
  - an inducted member can take the chainsaw
  - a class-B tool needs no induction
  - an inducted member cannot take a chainsaw that is out or in repair

My first attempt to append the tests with a shell heredoc was denied, since only `bun test` and `bun run gate` are allowed. I added them with the Edit tool instead.
